item.title: AI Is Here to Replace Nuclear Treaties. Scared Yet?
item.description: The last major nuclear arms treaty between the US and Russia just expired. Some experts believe a combination of satellite surveillance, AI, and human reviewers can take its place. Others, not so much.

item.title: The Technologies Changing How You’ll Watch the 2026 Winter Olympic Games
item.description: From drones with “first-person” visualization to real-time 360-degree replays and Olympics GPT, get ready to immerse yourself in the Winter Games in Milan and Cortina.

item.title: Moltbook, the Social Network for AI Agents, Exposed Real Humans’ Data
item.description: Plus: Apple’s Lockdown mode keeps the FBI out of a reporter’s phone, Elon Musk’s Starlink cuts off Russian forces, and more.

item.title: New York Is the Latest State to Consider a Data Center Pause
item.description: Red and blue states alike have introduced legislation in recent weeks that would halt data center development, citing concerns from climate to high energy prices.

item.title: The Only Thing Standing Between Humanity and AI Apocalypse Is … Claude?
item.description: As AI systems grow more powerful, Anthropic’s resident philosopher says the startup is betting Claude itself can learn the wisdom needed to avoid disaster.

item.title: Loyalty Is Dead in Silicon Valley
item.description: Founders used to be wedded to their companies. Now, anyone can be lured away for the right price.

item.title: ICE and CBP’s Face-Recognition App Can’t Actually Verify Who People Are
item.description: ICE has used Mobile Fortify to identify immigrants and citizens alike over 100,000 times, by one estimate. It wasn't built to work like that—and only got approved after DHS abandoned its own privacy rules.

item.title: Hollywood Is Losing Audiences to AI Fatigue
item.description: Entertainment about or made with artificial intelligence has been missing the mark with viewers over the past year.

item.title: A New AI Math Startup Just Cracked 4 Previously Unsolved Problems
item.description: Axiom says its AI found solutions to several long-standing math problems, a sign of the technology’s steadily advancing reasoning capabilities.

item.title: Mistral's New Ultra-Fast Translation Model Gives Big AI Labs a Run for Their Money
item.description: “Too many GPUs makes you lazy,” says the French startup’s vice president of science operations, as the company carves out a different path than the major US AI companies.
